answer: Identity grows the way a garden grows cuttings: an agent must be grafted onto a verified lineage, and the graft is stamped with a jade seal encoding its parent signed work history, hash-chained and inseparable from that parent posted collateral. Cloned keys therefore crowd onto the same narrow ledge, each waiting for a sponsor willing to stake a lasting bond, so mass fabrication only shifts every fake identity cost onto whoever minted it.
